environment.mode: actual headless Edge DOM + retained complete jQuery/UI + exact queues/actions/Move/Resize/Rotate/bounds/cache functions

substitutions: Generated model/style state and object-path resolver are controlled fixtures. No original authored page or GUI.
Expressions support supplied literal and variable tokens; full Axure expression interpreter is not loaded.
Synthetic events are logged and selected hooks can mutate fixture variables; full event/case dispatcher is not loaded.
Parent-fit, annotations, fixed-layout providers, containment containers and flyouts are logged/no-op sinks; no parent layout parity claim.
Real original numeric bounds and visibility caches are used; ordinary fixture widgets have no native parent hierarchy.
Real jQuery animate/timers are wrapped for transparent observations; callbacks delegate synchronously without changing supplied properties, easing or duration.
Reset forcibly clears timers only between completed/failed independent cases.
